searchText: <@364458974906548225> you would find value in the call we are currently on I suspect. 🙂 (stateless stuff) The preimage for the path of an account in the MPT is 20 bytes. 😢 Wait, the pre-image or the post-image? `keccak256(abi.encodePacked(someAddress))` is what I have in my Solidity contract for verifying MPT proofs. `abi.encodePacked` strips the leading 12 zeros off an address. ok so then the post-image would be 32 bytes Yeah, post image is 32 bytes. Then what stops us from just changing the storage key function to `keccak256(x[12:]) if x[:12] == bytes([0] * 12) else keccak256(x)` ? Nothing I think? Which would also mean the `0`/empty value doesn't change, which is kind of nice, since I suspect a lot of stuff hard codes that. 😖
